name: Kerjaya Prospek Group Berhad
summary: Kerjaya Prospek Group Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the construction of high-end commercial and high-rise residential buildings in Malaysia. The company operates through Construction, Manufacturing, Properties, Hospitality, and Others segments. The Construction segment is involved in the main building construction works; and provision of contract workmanship and other related services. The Manufacturing segment engages in the manufacturing, assembly, installation, and sale of light fittings, furniture, and kitchen cabinetry and related products.
